text:
ڈنڈے ڈنڈے باجرا — ڈڈ ٹپ جوار،
گھنی کنک — اٹھ بہے ونڈوار۔
romanized:
Dandé dandé bajra—dadd tapp jawar,
Ghani kanak—utth béhé vandvar.
literal_en: Sow bajra at a furrow's distance, jawar as far apart as a frog jumps, wheat close together, cotton so far apart that a camel could sit down between the plants.

source.book: Grammar and Dictionary of Western Panjabi, as spoken in the Shahpur District, with Proverbs, Sayings and Verses
